definition_en: a leafy shelter formed by trees or climbing plants on a frame; formerly, a tree
core_image: 藤蔓爬满木架：绿色的屋顶下藏着一张长凳
scene: 花园深处，葡萄藤在头顶交缠，阳光漏下点点碎金。The couple sat reading beneath the rose arbor.
sceneCN: 这里 arbor 是「藤架、凉亭」（第 1 个义项：植物搭成的荫棚）；句意为：这对伴侣坐在玫瑰花架下读书。

derivatives.zh: 同根形容词，义为「树的；栖于树的」
同根名词，义为「植物园；树木园」
复合称谓，义为「树木园管理员」

senses.title: A shelter of climbing plants
senses.definition: a frame over which vines or roses are trained to make a leafy shelter
senses.definitionCN: 藤蔓或蔷薇攀爬其上形成绿荫的架子
senses.exampleCN: 紫藤爬满了园中的藤架。
senses.why: The root means tree; a leafy shelter is a small made tree.
senses.whyCN: 词根本义是树；绿荫棚就是一座人造小树。

senses.title: A garden retreat
senses.definition: a shady nook in a garden for sitting and resting
senses.definitionCN: 园中供人落座休息的荫凉角落
senses.example: Grandmother shelled peas in the arbor.
senses.exampleCN: 祖母坐在凉亭里剥豌豆。
senses.why: Once the shelter exists, the place itself takes the name.
senses.whyCN: 荫棚一旦落成，其所在之处便承袭其名。

senses.title: A tree itself (archaic)
senses.definition: in older botanical and poetic use, a tree
senses.definitionCN: 旧时植物学与诗歌用语中指树木
senses.example: Old herbals divided plants into arbor, frutex, and herba.
senses.exampleCN: 古老的本草书把植物分为乔木、灌木与草本。
senses.why: This is the root meaning, kept in learned Latin labels.
senses.whyCN: 这是词根本义，保存在学术性的拉丁语标签中。

senses.title: The axis of a wheel or machine
senses.definition: the central shaft or spindle on which something turns
senses.definitionCN: 供部件旋转的中心轴或主轴
senses.example: The saw blade mounts on the arbor.
senses.why: A different Latin arbor (a shaft) blended with the tree word.
senses.whyCN: 另一个拉丁词 arbor（轴）与「树」一词混融。

senses.title: Anatomy: the arbor vitae
senses.definition: a branching structure resembling a tree, as in the cerebellum
senses.definitionCN: 形似树枝的分叉结构，如小脑中的生命之树
senses.example: The slice revealed the arbor vitae of the cerebellum.
senses.exampleCN: 切片显露出小脑的生命之树结构。
senses.why: Bodies grow trees too, so anatomy borrowed the image.
senses.whyCN: 身体里也长树，解剖学便借用了这一意象。

senses.title: A ceremonial or symbolic tree
senses.definition: a tree or tree-shaped structure used in festivals or as a symbol
senses.definitionCN: 节庆中使用的树或树形构筑物，作为象征
senses.example: Villagers raised a may arbor for the spring fair.
senses.exampleCN: 村民为春季集市竖起了五月花柱凉棚。
senses.why: Trees carry meanings: shelter, life, and gathering.
senses.whyCN: 树承载意义：庇护、生命与相聚。

senses.title: A family name of places
senses.definition: used in place names, most famously Ann Arbor
senses.definitionCN: 用于地名，最著名的是安阿伯（Ann Arbor）
senses.example: They moved to Ann Arbor for graduate school.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为读研搬到了安阿伯。
senses.why: Trees mark settlements, and the names stay.
senses.whyCN: 树标识了聚落，名字便留存下来。

senses.title: The cultivated green canopy
senses.definition: the trained leafy roof itself, as a garden element
senses.definitionCN: 作为园艺要素的、经修整的绿叶顶棚
senses.example: Pruning keeps the arbor dense and cool.
senses.exampleCN: 修剪使藤棚茂密而阴凉。
senses.why: The living roof is the point, more than the frame.
senses.whyCN: 有生命的顶棚才是关键，而非架子本身。

intro.en: Arbor is Latin for tree, and its English garden sense grew by way of Old French herbier and erber, a plot of green.
intro.cn: arbor 是拉丁语「树」，英语的园艺义经古法语 herbier/erber（绿地）演变而来。

items.en: The reconstructed root *h3erb- denoted plants or produce, source of Latin arbor.
items.cn: 重构词根 *h3erb- 指植物、出产，是拉丁语 arbor 的来源。

items.en: Arbor meant a tree, distinguished from shrubs and herbs.
items.cn: arbor 意为乔木，区别于灌木与草本。

items.en: Erber, from Latin herba, meant a grassy plot; herbier a green shelter.
items.cn: erber（源自拉丁语 herba）指草地；herbier 指绿色荫棚。

items.en: English blended arbor with erber, fixing the garden-shelter sense.
items.cn: 英语把 arbor 与 erber 融合，固定了「园中荫棚」之义。

items.en: Arbor now names garden shelters, with the tree sense alive in arboretum and arborist.
items.cn: 如今 arbor 指园中凉棚，树义则活在 arboretum、arborist 中。

note.en: Arbor heads a family of tree words and is often confused with harbor.
note.cn: arbor 是一族树词之首，且常与 harbor 混淆。

entries.definition: a sheltered port; to shelter or hide
entries.definitionCN: 港湾；窝藏——只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a garden of trees for study and display
an open frame for climbing plants

normalIntro.en: The tree-root family makes arbor and all its cousins easy.
normalIntro.cn: 「树」词根一族让 arbor 及其亲戚们全都好记。

normal.en: arbor is Latin for tree; the shelter is a little man-made tree.
normal.cn: arbor 是拉丁语「树」；荫棚就是人造的小树。

normal.en: Same family: arboreal (tree-dwelling), arboretum (tree garden), arborist (tree doctor).
Arbor Day is the tree-planting holiday.
normal.cn: 植树节的英文名就是 Arbor Day。

normal.en: Contrast: arbor shelters plants; harbor shelters ships.
normal.cn: 对照：arbor 庇护植物，harbor 庇护船只。

normal.en: Place name: Ann Arbor keeps the old word alive.
normal.cn: 地名：Ann Arbor 让这个古词留存至今。

abstract.en: A green roof growing on wooden bones, cool shade underneath.
abstract.cn: 绿色屋顶长在木骨之上，底下是一片阴凉。

abstract.en: A giant leafy umbrella you can sit inside.
abstract.cn: 一把可以坐进去的巨大绿叶伞。

abstract.en: Arbor sounds like 'harbor' — the harbor of the garden, sheltering vines.
abstract.cn: arbor 听着像 harbor——花园的港湾，庇护着藤蔓。

examples.en: Grapes ripened over the old arbor.
examples.cn: 葡萄在老藤架上渐渐成熟。

examples.en: They built an arbor at the end of the garden path.
examples.cn: 他们在花园小径尽头搭了一座藤架。

examples.en: Birds nested in the arbor all summer.
examples.cn: 整个夏天，鸟儿都在凉棚里筑巢。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿婆」——阿婆最爱坐在藤架下乘凉，arbor 就是阿婆的凉棚，谐音仅助记。

root: 拉丁词根 arbor-（树）：本义为乔木；英语园艺义「藤架、凉亭」经古法语 erber（绿地）混融而来，另有一个同形拉丁词 arbor（轴）产生「机轴」义；同根词有 arboreal、arboretum、arborist。

sensesIntro.en: From the Latin tree, arbor branches into plant shelters, garden retreats, the archaic tree sense, machine shafts, anatomical trees, ceremonial trees, place names, and the cultivated canopy.
sensesIntro.cn: 从拉丁语「树」出发，arbor 分叉出植物荫棚、花园休憩处、古义树、机轴、解剖之树、仪式之树、地名与人工绿冠。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a living green roof over a quiet seat
core.cn: 核心意象：静谧座席之上的绿色活屋顶

branches.en: the made tree: frames and trained canopies
branches.cn: 人造之树：构架与修整的绿冠

branches.en: places beneath branches where people rest and gather
branches.cn: 枝叶之下人们休憩相聚之所

branches.en: trees kept in learned language: botany and anatomy
branches.cn: 留在学术语言中的树：植物学与解剖学

branches.en: the other arbor: turning axes in machines
branches.cn: 另一个 arbor：机器中的转轴

branches.en: names that keep trees in place and memory
branches.cn: 让树留在地名与记忆中的名字

intro.en: Arbor heads a quiet family of learned tree words in English.
intro.cn: arbor 是英语中一族学术树词之首。

latinIntro.en: Latin arbor (tree) meets Greek dendron (tree) in pairs like arbor day versus dendrology.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 arbor（树）与希腊语 dendron（树）在诸多成对术语中相遇。

items.example: the arbor vitae of the cerebellum
the arboretum curator led the tour
items.exampleCN: 树木园管理员领队参观

derivatives.zh: 同根派生，义为「树的；栖于树的」
